maddeler.e:
ننتشل (form VIII)
# نَنْتَشِلُ (nantašilu) /nan.ta.ʃi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# نُنْتَشَلُ (nuntašalu) /nun.ta.ʃa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# نَنْتَشِلَ (nantašila) /nan.ta.ʃi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# نُنْتَشَلَ (nuntašala) /nun.ta.ʃa.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
